$createBackup.description: Creates a backup of the specified database

$removeBackup.description: Removes a backup of the specified data type

$restoreBackup.description: Restores database from backup if the database is not active

$leaderBoard.description: Loads the entire sorted ranked list into the environment variable

$nearbyBoard.description: Shows the count of competitors before and after the entity in the leaderboard

$pageBoard.description: Loads a paginated leaderboard slice into the environment variable

$positionBoard.description: Returns the position of the specified entity in the ranked list

$activeDB.description: Returns a list of active databases

$closeDB.description: Closes the connection to one or more databases

$keysDB.description: Retrieves all keys from the database

$openDB.description: Opens a connection to one or more databases

$prefetchDB.description: Prefetches database entries into memory to speed up future access

$rangeDB.description: Retrieves all records from the database

$searchDB.description: Searches the database with various filters

type.description: Data type (if not specified, searches all open databases)

$hold.description: Applies a hold timer to prevent repeated actions

$existsRecord.description: Checks if a record exists for the key

$getRecord.description: Saves record data into an environment variable

$moveRecord.description: Moves data from one record to another

delete source.description: Whether to delete source record after moving (default: true)

$putRecord.description: Sets new data for the key

$removeRecord.description: Deletes the record of the specified key

$valueRecord.description: Gets a variable value from a record
